heroSummary: The Bambu Lab A1 handles eSUN PLA+ straight out of the box with exceptional reliability, pushing up to 262 mm/s safely within a 22 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. Thanks to non-abrasive additives and low thermal shrinkage, no hardened nozzle upgrade or chamber enclosure is required.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (no adhesive required; ensure surface is cleaned with isopropyl alcohol)
slicerTweaks: Cap the Max Volumetric Speed at 22 mm³/s in the Filament Profile to prevent high-speed underextrusion.
Set Printing Temperature to 215°C for standard layers and 220°C for the first layer to maximize bed adhesion.
Tune Pressure Advance (Linear Advance) to approximately 0.024 for the stock direct drive extruder using the OrcaSlicer PA tower.
Enable Scarf Joint Seam or set Seam Position to 'Aligned' with Seam Gap at 10% to eliminate surface zits at high speeds.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Inadequate first layer bed temperature or drafts cooling the lower perimeter on the open-frame bed.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Increase bed temperature to 62°C, set first layer fan speed to 0% for the first 3 layers, and clean the PEI plate thoroughly with dish soap and warm water.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Matte finish and weak layer bonding on fast outer walls
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Exceeding the melt rate of eSUN PLA+ at default high print accelerations.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Lower outer wall speed to 150 mm/s or increase hotend temperature to 225°C to restore melt pool fluidity and gloss.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Stringing and wisps across travel moves
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PLA+ modifiers increase melt viscosity and elasticity, causing oozing if wipe distance is insufficient.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Enable 'Wipe while retracting' with a 2.0 mm wipe distance and ensure retraction speed is set to 35 mm/s.

faq.question: Can I use the Bambu Lab High Flow or Generic PLA preset for eSUN PLA+?
faq.answer: Yes, but you should adjust the Max Volumetric Speed to 22 mm³/s and set the printing temperature to 215°C, as eSUN PLA+ requires slightly higher heat than standard PLA.

faq.question: Do I need a hardened steel nozzle to print eSUN PLA+ on the A1?
faq.answer: No, eSUN PLA+ is non-abrasive, so the stock stainless steel nozzle on the Bambu Lab A1 provides full durability without accelerated wear.

faq.question: Is an enclosure recommended for eSUN PLA+ on the Bambu Lab A1?
faq.answer: No, an enclosure is not recommended because PLA+ requires rapid cooling; enclosing the open-frame A1 could increase chamber temperatures and risk heat creep clogs.

faq.question: How do I avoid filament feeding issues in the AMS Lite with eSUN cardboard spools?
faq.answer: Use printable snap-on spool rim adapters or wind the filament onto a Bambu reusable spool to prevent cardboard dust accumulation and ensure smooth rolling on the AMS Lite.
